image_description: An open orange ring binder lying flat on a light surface. The left side shows the inner cover with a clear plastic pocket containing a pink grid paper insert. The insert features hand-drawn diagrams (circles and shapes) and handwritten text in red and green ink, including what appears to be 'Fishes of [?]' and other labels. The right side shows the orange back cover. The metal ring mechanism is visible at the top hinge area, though partially obscured by the angle.
